user.title: Todoist Extras
user.description: Paste your Todoist API token. Find it in Todoist under Settings > Integrations > Developer.

reauth_confirm.title: Todoist token stopped working
reauth_confirm.description: Paste a new API token for the same Todoist account.

abort.already_configured: This Todoist account is already added.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Todoist account.

not_loaded.message: No Todoist Extras account is loaded.

pick_entry.message: More than one Todoist account is set up; give config_entry_id.

task_not_found.message: No single open Todoist task matches "{task}" (use its id or exact name; completed tasks cannot be used).

empty_comment.message: Give the comment some text or a file.

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant is not allowed to read {file}; add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs.

add_comment.name: Add comment
add_comment.description: Adds a comment to a Todoist task or project, optionally with a file such as an audio recording.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Todoist account is set up.

task.name: Task
task.description: Id or exact name (if unique) of an open task.

project.name: Project
project.description: Project id or name, to comment on the project instead of a task.

content.name: Text
content.description: The comment text (Markdown). Defaults to the file name when a file is given.

file.name: File
file.description: Full path of a file to attach, e.g. /media/recordings/note.mp3. Its folder must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

add_subtask.name: Add subtask
add_subtask.description: Adds a subtask under an existing Todoist task.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Todoist account is set up.

task.name: Parent task
task.description: Id or exact name (if unique) of an open task.

due_string.name: Due
due_string.description: Optional due date in Todoist's own words, e.g. "tomorrow 5pm".
